name: relate
description: Link notes both ways through ordinary properties, then browse and search them by relationship, date or meaning.
author: Les Joseph

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run bundle
scripts.test: tsx --test test/pure.test.ts test/paths.test.ts test/semantic.test.ts test/settings-store.test.ts && esbuild test/sync.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:obsidian=./test/fake-obsidian.ts --outfile=.test/sync.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test .test/sync.mjs
